message: I need a checklist for packing a small carry-on for a four-day trip. The forecast says rain on two days, and I will have access to a washing machine once. I plan to walk a lot, so comfortable shoes matter more than formal clothes. Please include a reminder to check the airline liquid limit, but do not assume a specific allowance.
